description: Land Title Settlement Department - Senakudirippuwa, Puttalam D/S Division, Puttalam District - Cad Map No. 410112
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding ownership of specific land parcels. It contains detailed schedules listing land parcel numbers, owners, extents, and title classifications, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land registrations and property ownership matters.
